body:
Flat Gap Baptist Church sits on Flat Gap Drive in Flat Gap, Kentucky, in the low, level saddle between Lower Laurel Creek and Mudlick Creek in Johnson County.

Brother Harold Salyer was the pastor from 1964 through 1991 and still faithfully attends today.

Pastor Eric Lauterwasser serves the church today. Each September the church puts on a Fish Fry and Gospel Sing for the whole community.
